question.text: The blizzard approach to debt repayment is:

answer.text: A combination of snowball first, then switching to avalanche
Paying all debts simultaneously in equal proportions
Taking a new loan to pay off all existing debts

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 86 of the workbook defines the blizzard approach as a mixture of the avalanche and snowball methods — it starts with snowball (smallest balance first) and then switches to avalanche to pay the highest-interest-rate debt. The Trap: Blizzard is not the same as either avalanche or snowball alone — it is a hybrid that uses them in sequence. Note: The phasing — quick early wins via snowball, then minimising interest cost via avalanche — is the defining feature of the blizzard approach.
